reauth_confirm.title: Renew DESLOC session
reauth_confirm.description: Capture a new session for the same lock and enter it below.

session.title: DESLOC app session
session.description: Enter the current session from the DESLOC app. All locks returned by the account are added automatically. C100 Plus is tested; other models are marked experimental. Reauthentication is required if the session expires or is revoked.

menu_options.account: Sign in with email and password

account.title: DESLOC account
account.description: Signing in here can sign the DESLOC phone app out of the same account. To keep the app session, use the captured-session option. HA saves the resulting session token, not your password. A revoked session requires reauthentication; HA will not log in automatically. All locks returned by the account are added automatically. C100 Plus is tested; other models are marked experimental.

verification.title: Verify this installation
verification.description: Enter the code DESLOC sent to your account email. The code is used once and is not saved.

error.invalid_auth: DESLOC rejected these credentials. Check the account or capture a new session.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the DESLOC device list.
error.no_devices: No locks were returned for this account.
error.device_mismatch: This session does not contain the configured lock.
error.invalid_account: Enter your DESLOC email and password.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_send_code: DESLOC could not send a code. Wait before starting setup again.
error.captcha_required: Complete the security challenge in the DESLOC app, then try again. Captured-session setup is also available.
error.clock_error: Synchronize the Home Assistant host clock and try again.

abort.device_mismatch: This account does not contain the configured lock.
abort.no_devices: No locks were returned for this account.
abort.devices_added: All discovered locks have been added. Open DESLOC under Devices & services to see them.
abort.devices_updated: The session was updated for all discovered locks. No duplicate entries were created.
abort.invalid_discovery: The lock could not be added. Start DESLOC setup again.
abort.already_in_progress: This lock is already being configured.

init.title: Add a permanent PIN user
init.description: Create a new regular user on this lock and install a permanent PIN over Wi-Fi. Use a unique name and 6–8 digits. Submit creates access to the lock. The PIN is not saved in Home Assistant. If the result is uncertain, check DESLOC before trying again.

error.invalid_pin_user: Enter a name of 1–24 characters and a PIN of 6–8 digits.

abort.unavailable: The lock integration is unavailable. No changes were attempted. Restore its connection first.
abort.already_submitted: This request was already submitted. Check DESLOC before starting another.
abort.user_exists: A user with this name already exists. No changes were made, and the PIN you entered was not installed or compared with the existing PIN. Manage this user in the DESLOC app.
abort.pin_creation_uncertain: PIN creation was not confirmed. The user or PIN may already exist. Check the DESLOC app before trying again.
abort.command_in_progress: Another command is already in progress for this lock. No changes were attempted. Wait for it to finish before starting a new request.
abort.pin_preflight_failed: Could not check the existing users or PIN records. No changes were attempted. Restore the connection or reauthenticate if required, then check the DESLOC app before trying again.
abort.existing_user_pin_unconfirmed: A user with this name already exists, but an installed PIN record with its name was not confirmed. No changes were made. Check and manage this user in the DESLOC app before trying again; Home Assistant will not add a PIN to an existing user.
